title: How I got my land patent & 4* passport, rescinded USFS charges twice (building Dept 3 times)...
summary: Promoter's update claiming dismissed tickets by rescinding them and denying signatures, a passport without a Social Security number, and a land patent.

assertions.quote: recision's real so it's going to court and winning and trial saying it's not your ticket

verdicts.note: Courts do not dismiss citations because a defendant rejects or disowns them; reported dismissals have ordinary causes.

assertions.quote: i just started sending them certified mail and they quit bothering me

verdicts.note: Notices and affidavits have no legal effect on permit or code enforcement; a lull in letters is an anecdote.

assertions.quote: i got my passport four star without a social security number

verdicts.note: The State Department can issue a passport without an SSN, but the IRS may fine the applicant and it confers no special status.
